other_conditions: Applicant must be a bonafide full‑time regular student of the University of Delhi at undergraduate or postgraduate level
Students in their final year or final semester are not eligible
Applicant can be enrolled in any course or stream; no discipline restriction
benefits_summary: Stipend of ₹5,000 per month (₹10,500 per month for summer interns) and a certificate of experience from the Dean of Students' Welfare.
